an3.53:2.3: A greedy person … does bad things by way of body, speech, and mind.
an3.53:2.4: When greed has been given up, they don’t do bad things by way of body, speech, and mind.
an3.53:2.5: A greedy person … doesn’t truly understand what’s for their own good, the good of another, or the good of both.
an3.53:2.6: When greed has been given up, they truly understand what’s for their own good, the good of another, or the good of both.
